My dear [Mrs Johns](../persons.html#772),
I am afraid my [mother](../persons.html#1606) can hardly venture to the entertainment your elegant little square so pleasantly holds out, but I hope I may be able to come - and if it is any convenience to you in making arrangements I could take up [Miss Wilford](../persons.html#1520) and bring her back, but pray do not trouble yourself to answer

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
